workflow.action: Watch churn signals and run saves within authority
workflow.description: Triage signals into actionable and structural, answer the actionable with authorized levers, route pricing to the retention desk
workflow.gate: every save documents its lever and authority; no unauthorized promise appears anywhere in the log

workflow.description: Intake and triage every customer issue honestly, drive carrier tickets through partner channels with evidence and schedule
workflow.gate: every issue shows a triage category, an affiliation-honest framing, and a timestamped carrier trail where applicable

workflow.description: Attach new streams only from documented needs surfaced at reviews, renewals, refreshes, and resolved escalations, with authorization checks
workflow.artifact: expansion pipeline tied to lifecycle events
workflow.gate: every attach traces to a documented need, a same-cycle authorization check, and a disclosure-first close

workflow.action: Review the book's mix, exposure, and continuity
workflow.description: Roll up mechanism mix, concentration, churn, and clawback bands; verify agreement survivability terms; trigger diversification at thresholds
workflow.gate: bands are current, survivability terms are verified per agreement, and threshold crossings show documented decisions

priority_rationale: The frame and intake nodes come first because everything downstream reads from them: verified current terms, conduct rules, compliance boundaries, and a clean intake feed the ledger and health register that are the subdomain's two substrates; compensation tracking (reconciliation, disputes, clawback) must run before the book's economics can be trusted; the lifecycle motions (renewal, refresh, review) and the retention and escalation layers operate on those substrates account by account; and the portfolio and continuity views come last because they roll everything up into the redirection decisions that keep the book compounding instead of quietly eroding.

dominance_rules.rule: The current program document dominates every remembered or assumed term
dominance_rules.rationale: programs change compensation mechanisms, products, and rules without the agent's consent; memory is a stale cache
dominance_rules.trigger: any lifecycle commitment - renewal quote, save offer, expansion attach, win-back pursuit - is about to be made
dominance_rules.action: re-verify the relevant terms in the current program documents the same cycle, and reference the verification in the commitment record

dominance_rules.rule: Program compliance dominates any save, growth, or convenience play
dominance_rules.rationale: forfeiture and termination for cause destroy the whole book faster than any churn event
dominance_rules.trigger: a play would use an unauthorized product, an unapproved representation, or an order that does not match documented consent
dominance_rules.action: block the play; find an authorized lever or route the decision to the carrier

dominance_rules.rationale: a renewal or attach won by omission becomes a dispute, a regret churn, or a complaint that outweighs the win
dominance_rules.trigger: term mechanics, auto-renewal, or exit consequences are about to be skipped or softened to keep a close on track
dominance_rules.action: disclose plainly before signature even at the cost of the deal, and document the disclosure

dominance_rules.rule: Service resolution dominates selling on any account with an open issue
dominance_rules.rationale: selling into active pain reads as indifference and converts recoverable accounts into justified departures
dominance_rules.trigger: a renewal, expansion, or win-back touch is scheduled while the account has an unresolved escalation
dominance_rules.action: pause the selling motion until the issue is resolved or visibly owned with the customer's acknowledgment

dominance_rules.rationale: letting a customer believe the agent is the carrier is misrepresentation that breaches the program and poisons trust when discovered
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer's words or expectations imply the agent operates the network or owns the account
dominance_rules.action: state the partner relationship plainly while taking real ownership of what the agent can actually drive

dominance_rules.rule: Mechanism honesty dominates any demand for a specific number
dominance_rules.rationale: compensation figures, prices, and account multiples vary by program, plan version, and deal; invented precision becomes a false promise
dominance_rules.trigger: a projection, quote, or book valuation is requested
dominance_rules.action: state the mechanism and the qualitative band, and attach the verification path to the current program document

dominance_rules.rule: The dispute-window clock dominates batching convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: most programs bar disputes after a defined window, converting recoverable variances into permanent write-offs
dominance_rules.trigger: reconciliation or dispute work is about to slip past a cycle
dominance_rules.action: file in-window variances now, even provisionally, rather than waiting for a complete batch

dominance_rules.rule: Address-level re-qualification dominates any serviceability assumption
dominance_rules.rationale: coverage maps, overbuild announcements, and old service records are not facts about a specific suite today
dominance_rules.trigger: a refresh, relocation, expansion site, or win-back involves any address or technology change
dominance_rules.action: route through the site-qualification process before any commitment is voiced to the customer

dominance_rules.rule: Customer viability honesty dominates residual protection
dominance_rules.rationale: locking a struggling business into commitments it cannot carry is unethical and usually claws back anyway
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer in visible distress is up for renewal, save, or expansion
dominance_rules.action: right-size down honestly, present the cheaper adequate option, and document the customer's informed choice

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the current plan version before seeding any ledger expectation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-basing the entire ledger and re-arguing settled disputes after a plan change is discovered months late

anti_rework_rules.rule: Seed the ledger and health register at intake, not at first problem
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing account history from email archaeology in the middle of a dispute or churn fight

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconcile every cycle inside the dispute window
anti_rework_rules.prevents: recoverable variances aging into permanent write-offs and stale months being re-litigated from memory

anti_rework_rules.rule: Open the renewal work-back before the auto-renew notice cutoff
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unwinding silently rolled terms with an angry customer and a carrier process stacked against the change

anti_rework_rules.rule: Check the refresh horizon before proposing any renewal term length
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-papering or fighting to exit a long term that a retirement or overbuild made wrong within months

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm save-offer authority with the current program before the customer conversation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: retracting an unauthorized promise, which loses the save and damages trust twice

anti_rework_rules.rule: Route every address or technology change through re-qualification before commitment
anti_rework_rules.prevents: redesigning a promised solution after the serviceability check fails at the specific suite

anti_rework_rules.rule: Log escalations, disputes, and consents as they happen with references
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding evidence trails from scratch when a comp dispute, conduct question, or churn post-mortem needs them

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same statement variance class recurs across cycles for one program
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the current plan version, re-base the ledger's expectations from the effective date, and bundle the recurring lines into one systemic dispute

iteration_protocol.trigger: clawback frequency rises on a cohort of recent activations
iteration_protocol.action: audit intake quality and first-bill outcomes for the cohort and feed the deal-profile pattern upstream to qualification and discovery

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier announces or reschedules a retirement, overbuild, or generation change touching the book
iteration_protocol.action: re-enumerate affected accounts, re-verify the refresh compensation class, and re-time open renewal plays whose term length the event changes

iteration_protocol.trigger: a save play fails and the account churns
iteration_protocol.action: write the post-mortem with loss reason and failed levers, enter the account into the win-back pipeline, and update the signal watch for what was missed

iteration_protocol.trigger: a program change notice, agreement amendment, or upstream corporate event arrives
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify terms and survivability language, recompute mix and continuity exposure, and adjust open plays before any further commitments

iteration_protocol.trigger: escalation volume spikes for one account or one carrier
iteration_protocol.action: review the escalation paths and stalling tiers, brief the affected customers honestly, and weigh the pattern as a churn signal

iteration_protocol.trigger: expansion attach outcomes sour - regret churn or clawbacks on attached services
iteration_protocol.action: audit the documented-need gate on recent attaches and rebalance toward review-surfaced needs rather than target-driven pushes

iteration_protocol.trigger: the portfolio dashboard shows a band crossing its threshold (residual erosion, concentration, early churn)
iteration_protocol.action: redirect the coming cycle's lifecycle effort to the flagged motion and record the reallocation decision
